query:
SELECT b.id, b.status, b.sessionDate, b.sessionStartTime, b.sessionEndTime, b.lessonType, b.notes,
       u.name, u.email
FROM bookings b
LEFT JOIN users u ON b.userId = u.id
WHERE b.sessionDate = '2026-03-18'
AND b.status NOT IN ('cancelled')
ORDER BY b.sessionStartTime;
